about.bio: Full-stack developer building production mobile apps and backends with TypeScript — React Native/Expo on the client, NestJS and PostgreSQL on the server.

projects.name: Weyro
projects.desc: Automotive repair marketplace for India connecting vehicle owners with workshops, garages and spare-parts distributors.
projects.long: Weyro lets vehicle owners post damage/repair requests with photos, receive quotations from nearby workshops, book and pay in INR through Razorpay, and chat in real time. The Expo SDK 58 / React Native app talks to a NestJS 11 modular monolith on PostgreSQL 16 + PostGIS, with domain state machines for requests, quotes, bookings and payments, S3 presigned uploads with EXIF stripping, Socket.IO chat, Expo push notifications, JWT refresh rotation, role-based guards, Redis rate limiting, and deployment on Railway and EAS.

projects.name: Project Decode
projects.desc: Interactive 3D globe news site — click any country to see what its outlets have reported in the last 48 hours.
projects.long: Project Decode is a newsroom-style site built around a clickable three.js globe. Picking a country or continent pulls the last 48 hours of local coverage from Google News RSS (10-minute cache, deduplicated). The homepage aggregates publisher RSS into sections (World, Geopolitics, Finance, Tech & AI, Science, Climate, Health, Culture) with a 'country in focus' pick, an INR exchange-rate strip from ECB reference rates, and an image pipeline that falls back from publisher photos to openly licensed Openverse matches to bundled public-domain art. The logo is a potrace-traced vector with a CSS-animated intro. No API keys, no database.
